# Bayard Auto Center

> Auto repair shop at 12569 Philips Hwy, Jacksonville, FL 32256 (Bayard area, Southside Jacksonville). Phone (904) 400-4100. Open Monday–Friday 8 AM–6 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday. Rated 4.7 stars from 325 Google reviews.

## Key facts
- Category: Auto repair shop
- Services: computer diagnostic scan; engine & transmission; heating & cooling (A/C); electrical & electronic; alignment; brakes; tires; inspections; oil change
- Appointments: required; book online at https://myshopmanager.com/request_appointment?v=JTdCNWI5NWQzNDUtOTJkYi00N2NmLWIzNWMtZWI4MTdhODI2OWJkJTdE
- Payments: credit cards, debit cards, NFC mobile payments
- Financing: Snap Finance (https://apply.snapfinance.com/snap-loan/landing); approval and terms set by Snap Finance
- Accessibility: wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking lot and restroom
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100057353174341
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=5491802092088924756
